moves.name: Side Special (Air, End)
notes: Land cancels: touching the ground during this move ends it with 4 or 24 frames of landing lag rather than the usual special-fall landing. Which value applies depends on when you land. Landing is not the only requirement: the cancel is behind a condition that cannot be read out of the code, so it will not always apply. The code names the move rather than this animation, so the figure may belong to another of its segments.

moves.name: Air Dodge
notes: FAF is HDR's runtime calculation rather than a param: the air dodge stalls for 28 frames and ends once the fighter has fallen 35 units, so it follows their gravity and fall speed.
Intangible on frames 4-26.
Landing lag is 10 frames, from common's `landing_frame_escape_air` — the param HDR's air dodge status hands the landing when the dodge ends on the ground.
